correctness.rationale: On each unit interval, Hermite derivative is s_j[Sprime+(m_j/s_j)Aprime+(m_(j+1)/s_j)Bprime], with two normalized endpoint slopes in [0,2] when s_j has nonzero sign, zero otherwise. The four corner polynomials are nonnegative on [0,1], so the interpolation has exactly |s_j| variation on each cell; the infinite sum yields individual variation preservation. H(a,b) has coordinate derivatives in [0,2]; a perturbation of one increment produces one monotone central response (variation 1) and two neighboring humps with variations 8u/27 and 8v/27. Thus a one-edge directional variation <=1+8(2+2)/27=59/27; integrate along finite changes, then telescope l1 increments and use lower-semicontinuity under local convergence. For baseline slopes (1,0,1) and epsilon inserted into the middle, exact ratio=1+32/[27(1+epsilon)] tends to 59/27. Independent symbolic derivative corner checks and exact rational witnesses epsilon=1/100,1/1000 match. No finite actual pair is claimed to attain the limit.
